text:
sam_sales: Heads up 1: BlueCrest's security vet wants confirmation: POC must keep inference and telemetry inside EU+UK only (no US). Can hosted do EU+UK-only routing and list exact subprocessors per country? Also need rough cost delta.

ravi_se: Yes. We support region scoping that can include EU regions + UK zones. Two paths: (1) Hosted scoped to allowed_regions (EU + eu-west-2 for London), (2) Short-term Dedicated London/EU pool if they want stronger tenancy.

sam_sales: They explicitly asked whether any background services (metrics/observability) reach US endpoints by default.

elaine_privsec: By default metrics are sharded to our central telemetry stack which might be US by default, but for an EU+UK-only POC we can enable EU/UK retention endpoints. We'll need to enable the eu-gb telemetry shard and mirror logs to UK/EU buckets only.

marta_legal: Contractually we'll provide a DPA + SCCs and a UK Addendum where required. If BlueCrest requires an explicit list of subprocessors by country for the POC term, legal can append an EU+UK subprocessor appendix.

ravi_se: Example routing snippet we give customers:

```yaml
routing_policy:
  mode: strict
  allowed_regions:
    - eu-west-1
    - europe-west2
    - eu-west-3
    - eu-west-2  # London
  fallback: none
```

ravi_se: With fallback:none, requests that cannot be served in those regions fail with 429/451; no cross-border routing occurs.

sam_sales: Any subprocessors in the UK we should call out? Customer is very picky about local processors.

elaine_privsec: Current EU+UK subprocessors used for scoped POCs: AWS (EU/UK zones), GCP (EU zones), UKCloud Ltd (UK managed logging), and EuroSecure Ops (EU SIEM). We'll produce a printable appendix.

sam_sales: Pricing 1: ballpark uplift vs default global hosted for a 3-week low-QPS POC?

ravi_se: Ballpark: Hosted EU+UK strict routing ~= +8-15% per-token uplift depending on requested queueing/guarantees. If they want guaranteed latency or dedicated London capacity -> Dedicated quote (setup + daily reservation). For low-QPS POC assume hosted +10% as safe estimate.

marta_legal: Note: if they want subprocessors contractually locked to EU+UK without substitution, legal will need review; that typically pushes this into an enterprise addendum.

deploy_bot: [infra-deploy] Published: eu-uk-subprocessors-2026-03-15 -> https://redwood.example.com/compliance/eu-uk-subprocessors

sam_sales: OK action items: (1) Ravi to draft the routing YAML + sample SOW sentence, (2) Marta to prepare DPA + EU+UK subprocessor appendix, (3) Elaine to produce a one-pager on telemetry routing and BYOK steps.

ravi_se: I'll drop the YAML + SOW by EOD with optional max_queue settings.

marta_legal: I'll compile the appendix and a short note about UK Addendum; ETA tomorrow morning.

elaine_privsec: I'll prepare BYOK/KMS steps (UK/EU endpoints) and the telemetry mirror instructions.

sam_sales: I'll send an email with the one-liners and propose a Wed kickoff. Also checking if they need model artifact residency (weights) 1: if yes, recommend Dedicated/Private.

ravi_se: Correct, if weights must never leave EU+UK during onboarding, Dedicated or Private is required; hosted can mirror artifacts but some bootstrap may fetch from upstream unless mirrored in advance.

sam_sales: Thanks all. Will update the deal doc after I hear back from BlueCrest.
